name: Omnicom
description: Omnicom is the largest of the advertising agency holding companies, owning networks of agencies that plan and buy media, create advertising, do public relations, run health-care marketing, build customer-data and e-commerce platforms, and run events, for large corporate clients in almost every industry. It completed its merger with The Interpublic Group of Companies (IPG) on November 26, 2025, with Omnicom as the accounting acquirer, so FY2025 includes about one month of IPG while 2026 includes a full period. Clients pay agency fees, commissions on media bought for them, incentive payments, and reimbursement of third-party costs the company handles. It reports one segment, made of four global agency networks, so profit by discipline is not disclosed. In 2025 restructuring and merger costs cut operating income to $444.7 million (2.6 percent margin) and produced a net loss; in H1 2026 the operating margin was 12.3 percent.

gics.note: Conventional label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source in this pass. SEC SIC code is 7311 (Services-Advertising Agencies). The box hides that Omnicom owns no media: it is a people business (salary and related costs were 45 percent of FY2025 revenue) that buys media on behalf of clients, with third-party service costs another 24 percent of revenue, and after the November 2025 Interpublic merger it also owns data assets (Acxiom) and a commerce/production business.

hq.note: 280 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10017 (Q2 2026 10-Q cover)

employees.note: About 120,000 worldwide after the Interpublic merger: 55,300 Americas, 38,000 EMEA, 26,700 Asia-Pacific; about 37,700 in the U.S. (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Media & Advertising
businessLines.how: Clients pay commissions based on their spend on media bought from third parties (recognised at a point in time, typically when the media runs), plus fees for planning and creative work, plus incentive payments tied to agreed measures; third-party costs the company controls are booked as revenue and cost.
businessLines.description: Strategic media planning, buying and optimization, data and analytics, creative services and content production (OMD, PHD, Hearts & Sciences, UM, Initiative, Mediahub; creative agencies BBDO, TBWA, McCann). In 2026 filings this is re-cut into 'Integrated Media' and 'Advertising'.

revenue.note: FY2024 $8,656.1M; +14.9% constant currency; includes about one month of IPG

businessLines.name: Precision Marketing
businessLines.how: Project and retainer fees for building and running customer-data, CRM and e-commerce systems, plus recurring data and platform licensing (Acxiom, Flywheel).
businessLines.description: Technology and digital transformation consulting, decision sciences, digital experience design, CRM, e-commerce and enterprise platforms (Omnicom Precision Marketing, MRM, Acxiom and Interact from IPG, Flywheel Commerce Cloud).

businessLines.name: Public Relations
businessLines.how: Monthly retainers and project fees paid by clients for staff time.
businessLines.description: Corporate communications, crisis management, public affairs and media relations (FleishmanHillard, Ketchum, Golin, Weber Shandwick).

businessLines.name: Healthcare
businessLines.how: Agency fees and commissions paid by pharmaceutical and health-care clients for campaigns and media.
businessLines.description: Advertising, corporate communications and media services for global health-care and pharmaceutical companies (Omnicom Health, including IPG Health).

businessLines.name: Branding & Retail Commerce
businessLines.how: Project and retainer fees for consulting and retail marketing work.
businessLines.description: Brand and product consulting, strategy and research, retail marketing.

businessLines.name: Experiential
businessLines.how: Per-event fees and production charges billed to clients, with third-party costs passed through.
businessLines.description: Live and digital events and experience design and execution.

businessLines.name: Execution & Support
businessLines.how: Fees per programme or per staffed activity paid by clients.
businessLines.description: Field marketing, sales support, and related execution services (includes production work).

brands.name: OMD, PHD, UM, Initiative, Mediahub, Hearts & Sciences
